summary: FAIL. The delivered work is correct. A clean rebuild from HEAD reproduces the cut-out, the sprites, the review sheet and the panel byte for byte. All eleven proportion rows and both palms pass. Two blockers remain, and both are process blockers. First, no phase acceptance covers Phases 6 to 9, and the Phase 9 asset commit bf4158a5 is not covered by the latest result. Second, plan.md T14 names five SHA-256 values and a pivot that do not match the delivered sprites. No implementation change is needed.

The passing results name Phases 1 to 2 (28ff7990), Phases 3 to 4 (75bb2b42) and Phase 5 (67cc8ce1). No result names Phase 6, 7, 8 or 9. The latest result audited 67cc8ce1. Fix: after the F2 record fix, run measure-phase-acceptance once on Phases 6 to 9, bound to the new HEAD, then run final acceptance again.
